description: Defines the LoanProductRelatedDetail class which encapsulates detailed configuration and parameters for loan products in the Fineract system, including interest rates, repayment schedules, and various financial strategies.

classes.name: LoanProductRelatedDetail
classes.description: Embeddable class representing detailed configuration parameters for loan products, including interest rates, repayment schedules, and various financial strategies.

methods.name: createFrom
methods.description: Static factory method to create an instance of LoanProductRelatedDetail with specified parameters.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns a copy of the currency associated with the loan product.

methods.name: getCurrencyData
methods.description: Returns the currency data object representing the currency.

methods.name: getPrincipal
methods.description: Returns the principal amount as a Money object.

methods.name: getInArrearsTolerance
methods.description: Returns the in-arrears tolerance as a Money object.

methods.name: getNominalInterestRatePerPeriod
methods.description: Returns the nominal interest rate per period, parsed from string to BigDecimal.

methods.name: getInterestPeriodFrequencyType
methods.description: Returns the interest period frequency type, or INVALID if null.

methods.name: getAnnualNominalInterestRate
methods.description: Returns the annual nominal interest rate, parsed from string to BigDecimal.

methods.name: getDaysInYearCustomStrategy
methods.description: Returns the custom strategy for days in year.

methods.name: hasCurrencyCodeOf
methods.description: Checks if the currency code matches the provided string.

methods.name: fetchDaysInMonthType
methods.description: Returns the days in month type enum based on stored integer.

methods.name: fetchDaysInYearType
methods.description: Returns the days in year type enum based on stored integer.

methods.name: updateForFloatingInterestRates
methods.description: Resets interest rate fields to null or invalid for floating interest rate scenarios.

methods.name: updateInterestRecognitionOnDisbursementDate
methods.description: Sets the interest recognition on disbursement date flag.
